about: Real MediaPipe Face Landmarker output (@mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.2.0, the Rigger bundle, 640 px, VIDEO mode) for the motion-amplitude gate. Each frame: [seconds, the 52 blendshape scores in `blendshapes` order, the face points in `points` order as [x, y] of the picture, and, on the talk clip, Face Landmarker's facial transformation matrix (16 numbers, column-major; recaptured 2026-11-19 from the same frames, every other value identical)] or null where no face was found. Regenerated by hand from the clips below; never fetched by the gate.

talk.source: NASA, "NASA's SpaceX Crew-1 Interviews: Shannon Walker" (jsc2020m000249), 13:50–14:06, 24 fps. NASA video, public domain in the United States.
